newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ING pulling out of commodity derivatives.
newsitem.headline: ING pulling out of commodity derivatives.

text.p: ING Groep NV said on Tuesday its ING Futures and Options unit was withdrawing from sales of commodity derivative brokerage and clearing services.
ING spokesman Wieger Sietsma said 40 jobs would be lost in Chicago and four in London as part of a reorganisation of the unit.
"They will leave the company in the near future," he told Reuters.
He said ING had decided to reorganise its futures and options business by focusing on the "truly financial" derivatives of equities, interest rates and foreign exchange.
Sietsma said about 400 staff remained within the future and options unit worldwide.
He said the unit would maintain its seats on the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange, Chicago Board of Trade and Chicago Mercantile Exchange.
"We want to offer a global service with 24 hour book management," he said, adding that the business would be expanded.
The derivatives operations would be managed from Amsterdam with regional centres in Chicago, London and Hong Kong.
